definitions.explanation: Impressively expensive-looking, elaborate, or extravagant. Describes things that are richly decorated, high-quality, or abundant in a way that conveys wealth and sophistication.

examples.japanese: {豪華|ごうか}な{料理|りょうり}が{並|なら}んでいる。
{誕生日|たんじょうび}に{豪華|ごうか}なプレゼントをもらった。
examples.english: I received a gorgeous present for my birthday.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}は{豪華|ごうか}な{客船|きゃくせん}で{開|ひら}かれることになった。
examples.english: This year's end-of-year party will be held on a luxurious cruise ship.

notes:
A positive word conveying impressiveness and richness. Unlike {贅沢|ぜいたく} which can imply wastefulness, {豪華|ごうか} is purely appreciative and is often used in advertising and media to attract customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪華|ごうか}{客船|きゃくせん}: luxury cruise ship
- {豪華|ごうか}な{食事|しょくじ}: lavish meal
- {豪華|ごうか}{絢爛|けんらん}: gorgeous and splendid
- {豪華|ごうか}な{顔|かお}ぶれ: star-studded lineup
- {豪華|ごうか}{賞品|しょうひん}: lavish prizes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}な: extravagant — can imply excessive or wasteful spending
- {華|はな}やかな: glamorous — emphasizes brightness and showiness
- {立派|りっぱ}な: magnificent — emphasizes dignified impressiveness
